regime_context: China A-shares show an extremely narrow rotation: only 2 of 22 themes pass the absolute-trend eligibility gate, with Coal leading marginally over Banks and a 'one-narrative' structure (absorption 0.33, one_narrative=true). Backtest verdict is explicit that the trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), so the detector's only validated edge is absent here — this is a display/focus lens, not an edge. Track record (n=89) shows direction accuracy of only 0.337, so any directional lean must be held at very low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching Coal vs Banks leadership margin: the current margin is only 0.065, and Coal's durability (0.54) is weaker than Banks' (0.78). If Banks' score overtakes Coal's score as challenger while both remain eligible, a confirmed handoff would be in progress (not a call, just an observation). Retire the watch if the margin widens back above 0.15 in Coal's favor.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only top-ranked theme that is eligible AND not crowded, with the highest score and the sole non-trend hurst_tag (mean-revert at 0.54 durability). The one-narrative structure means the market is focused here, and Coal is not showing a crowding flag (crowded=false, crowding_z=0.78), so there is no sizing caution. This is a relative-leadership lean, not a return forecast: the momentum rank is only a focus lens, and with gate_helps=false the trend gate gives no drawdown protection. Lean direction only, low conviction given dir_accuracy 0.337.
evidence: gate_helps=false limits any drawdown edge on this market
theses.dissent: Coal's mean-revert hurst tag and 0.54 durability suggest the leadership itself may be unstable; with no validated drawdown gate on China A-shares, the eligible theme can still whipsaw. The head-to-head margin over Banks is just 0.065 — effectively noise.

falsifier.text: Coal (515220.SS) underperforms Banks (512800.SS) by more than 2% cumulative before 2026-10-23

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the second eligible theme and actually have the highest durability (0.78) and strongest breadth (0.944) of any eligible name, with a proper trend hurst_tag. However, Banks are crowded (crowded=true, crowding_z=1.74), which is a sizing-down caution — NOT a fade. Given the guardrail to never fade the leading theme on a crowding flag, this is a relative-second-position lean rather than a contrarian short. Both eligible names point the same direction in a one-narrative market, so the lean is overweight with a cap, held at low conviction.
theses.dissent: Crowding z of 1.74 is high — the documented failure mode is treating crowding as a sell, but it does mean fragile hands are in this trade. A crowded trend theme on a mean-reverting tape has historically not paid drawdown-avoidance benefits here (gate_helps=false).
